content_sections.heading: TCGL Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required
content_sections.text: Updated CV/Resume A recent passport-size photograph Self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents Original certificates/documents related to educational qualification, experience, photo identity proof, and address proof Supporting documents from the competent authority for any name/surname/spelling discrepancy in certificates Female candidates who changed their surname after marriage must produce a marriage certificate and a notarized affidavit Candidates who fail to produce the required documents in both original and photocopy form will not be considered eligible for the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the TCGL Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: There is no online application for this recruitment, and no application fee is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: TCGL Recruitment 2026 - General Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement shall be purely on an outsource basis. TCGL/Ethos HR Management & Projects Limited reserves the right to accept or reject any application, modify eligibility criteria, increase or decrease vacancies, or cancel the recruitment process without assigning any reason. Candidature may be cancelled at any stage if any information or document submitted is found to be false, incorrect, or misleading. Selected candidates may be posted at any project location within Gujarat as per organizational requirements. Candidates shall participate in the walk-in interview at their own expense; no TA/DA shall be paid. Any dispute arising out of this recruitment process shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Gandhinagar. Candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before appearing for the walk-in interview; no separate communication will be made to ineligible candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is TCGL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment drive by Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited (TCGL), a Government of Gujarat undertaking, for 47 outsourced posts, conducted through Ethos HR Management & Projects Limited.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TCGL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 47 vacancies across 29 posts and 15 branches, including Audit, Commercial, Event, Finance, HR & Admin, IT, Land & Legal, Market Research, Project Branch, and Skill Development.

faq.question: Q3. When is the TCGL walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Technical posts will be interviewed on 07-09-2026, and Administrative posts on 08-09-2026, both at Gandhinagar. The Project Engineer (Ayodhya) post has a separate walk-in on 07-09-2026 at Ayodhya.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the TCGL walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: Most posts will be interviewed at Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited, Block No. 16/17, 4th Floor, Udhyogbhavan, Sector 11, Gandhinagar. The Project Engineer (Ayodhya) post will be interviewed at the Tourist Information Bureau, Ayodhya Cantt.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for TCGL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from a Bachelor's degree in any discipline for Office Assistant posts to MBA/PG Diploma, LLB/LLM, or B.E./B.Tech qualifications for Executive, Sr. Executive, and Engineering posts, each with a specified number of years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the remuneration for TCGL Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Remuneration ranges from ₹18,000 per month for Office Assistant posts to ₹55,000 per month for the Project Engineer (Ayodhya) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TCGL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview with document verification. Mandatory registration at the venue is required, and mere attendance at the interview does not guarantee selection.

faq.question: Q8. Is the TCGL recruitment for permanent government employment?
faq.answer: No. The notification specifies that engagement is purely on an outsource basis, to be deputed at Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited.
